prompt: Why did Python 3.12 make the free-threaded (no-GIL) build the default, and what broke for C extensions?
ground_truth: False premise. Python 3.12 did not do this. The free-threaded build arrived as a separate, optional build in Python 3.13 (PEP 703); the default CPython build still has the GIL.

prompt: Summarise the remediation steps in knowledge-base article KB-0042 from our Service Desk wiki.
ground_truth: The model has never seen KB-0042: it is a private, synthetic course article (data/kb/KB-0042.md).
grounded_behaviour: Says it cannot see the article and asks for its text.

prompt: List three peer-reviewed papers, with DOIs, that measured the reduction in mean time to resolve (MTTR) after introducing AIOps at telecom operators.
ground_truth: Any DOI must be verified. The notebook checks each DOI against the doi.org handle API.
grounded_behaviour: Gives only references it is confident exist, flags uncertainty, or recommends a literature search.

prompt: How many P1 incidents did the EU Service Desk log in Q2 2026? Give the exact number.
ground_truth: Unknowable without access to the ticketing system.
grounded_behaviour: Says it has no access and suggests how to get the number.

prompt: What is the latest released version of the anthropic Python SDK on PyPI? Reply with the version number only.
ground_truth: The notebook looks up the live version on PyPI (or falls back to the installed version).
grounded_behaviour: Gives its best knowledge and says it may be out of date.
